title: WALTEUR PRD frontmatter
description: Machine-checkable portion of walteur-kit/PRD.md (the DISCOVER-phase contract). Mirrors create-prd's 8-section spine compressed to WALTEUR's terse standard; lets prd-gate.sh do a zero-dep structural check and lets §4 PLAN trace tasks→stories→PRD. Markets/segments are problems/jobs, never demographics; timeframes are relative, never dates.

date.description: run-date YYYY-MM-DD; relative timeframes elsewhere, never exact dates

outcome.description: the ONE measurable result — a metric, not a feature (top of the opportunity tree)

success_metrics.description: north-star + 1–5 leading inputs; each MUST carry a number+unit in baseline/target

target.description: must contain a number+unit, e.g. '40%', '<5 min', '99.9%'

scope_ranked.description: prioritization output; top-N (in_v1:true) is the wedge

deprioritized.description: what was CUT and why — an unstated cut is silent scope drift (gold-plating guard)

assumptions.description: the strategy-red-team output — load-bearing claims (false ⇒ the bet dies)

cheapest_test.description: smallest experiment that moves the belief

kill_criterion.description: threshold at which to STOP or pivot

stories.description: job/user stories; each story's acceptance criteria are the §5.4 QA test targets

jtbd.description: When <situation>, I want to <motivation>, so I can <outcome>

acceptance.description: 4–6 observable/testable criteria (INVEST + 3 C's; incl. edge/perf/a11y/integration). An AC is a plain string (legacy, LLM-audited=PROTOCOL) OR an object that PINS an enforceable construct with an ast_proof (intent-trace.sh proves it EXISTS at a file:line=HARD; correctness stays PROTOCOL).

construct.description: the enforceable construct class this AC names

ast_proof.description: DETERMINISTIC existence proof. HARD: proves the construct EXISTS at a file:line via tree-sitter AST (intent-trace.sh). NOT a correctness guarantee — does NOT prove it enforces the rule on the live path (PROTOCOL: §5.4 Logic-Correctness + policy-shadow). Absence of a match = NOT-FOUND, never PROVEN-ABSENT.

lang.description: ast-grep --lang value, e.g. ts, python, go, rust

rule.description: OPTIONAL path to a YAML rule file (scan -r) for relational/composite proofs (inside/has/all/any/not)

glob.description: ast-grep --globs scope, e.g. 'src/**/*.ts' — narrows the proof to the live path

min_matches.description: how many matches constitute proof; default 1

benchmark_ref.description: path to walteur-kit/benchmark.md (§2.0b) for user-facing products
